'''2013 Texas Mini Worlds Day 1 James Barnes LS The Hyperdrive Generator's Gone''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[James Barnes]] at [[2013 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Day 1).

Typed slang printout (not a handwritten Xerox form).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[The Hyperdrive Generator's Gone / We'll Need A New One]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
